metadata.scope: 收录 3.3.0 正式客户端配置中的迷宫诡域物资。各等级、品质和任务变体保留独立编号；配置存在不代表本局一定可获得。
notes: 新增 56 条物资，原有 548 个编号保留，收藏无需迁移。
收录古怪能量烛、烛能芯核和拟态单质；不收录绳匠配饰及未具备独立物品依据的占位配置。
名称、说明与获取途径取自固定 3.3.0 正式配置和文本。配置价值不是商店兑换价格或实际出售报价。

tutorialRules.title: 玩法规则
paragraphs: 每次拾取拟态单质都有概率获得一项侵蚀症状，部分症状可叠加；拾取越多，出现重度侵蚀的概率越高。
背包和安全箱中的X/Y/Z各一枚会自动合成，单局可重复。合成本身不增加侵蚀；合成或丢弃单质不会清除已有症状，成功撤离后症状消失。

items.name: [易损][挽昼]心灯如帜-Lv.50
items.nameEn: [Fragile][Sunbringer] Lamp of the Heart, Raised as a Banner - Lv.50
items.description:
挽昼的专属战术棱镜。
装备同名武备时仅可触发一次，获得1个[骸影·梦游布]。发动「强力斩击」后，为敌人积攒1层残痕。15秒内最多触发一次。异体技造成的30%伤害可以转化为目标的[烬痕]。发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]命中敌人时，额外削减其25%「恶噪护盾」，该效果对同一名敌人仅可触发一次。
挽昼消耗锐能使用强化特殊技时，回复40点愿火。自身受到致命伤害时，立刻回复10%最大生命值，并获得生命值上限30%的护盾，持续60秒，每1200秒可以触发一次。发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]后，无视敌人32%防御力，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Sunbringer's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When equipping Gear of the same name, this effect can only trigger once, granting 1 [Etheric Phantom - Sleepwalkerboo]. After using "Strong Slash," apply 1 floor of Gash to the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 15s. 30% of DMG dealt by Alter Skills can be converted into the target's [Embermark]. When [Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades] hits an enemy, it deals an extra 25% reduction to their "Cacophony Shield." This effect can only trigger once per enemy.
When Sunbringer consumes Sharpness to use an EX Special Attack, restore 40 Wishfire. When taking fatal DMG, instantly restore 10% of Max HP and gain a shield equal to 30% of Max HP for 60s. This effect can trigger once every 1,200s. After using [Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades], ignore 32% of enemy DEF for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [易损][知更鸟]星河咏叹-Lv.50
items.description:
知更鸟的专属战术棱镜。
使用[骸影]时，全队角色获得相当于自身最大生命值10%的护盾，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。任意角色拥有护盾时，队伍受到的侵蚀值降低至原本的85%。
[强化特殊技：震律齐鸣]命中敌人时，降低其20%全属性伤害抗性，持续30秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；拥有[和鸣护盾]的角色造成的伤害提升20%，知更鸟被切换为当前操作中角色时获得1点[重音节拍]。
items.descriptionEn:
Robin's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When Etheric Phantom is used, all squad members gain a shield equal to 10% of their max HP, lasting 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When any character has a shield, Corruption taken by the squad is reduced to 85% of the original value.
When EX Special Attack: Seismic Chorus hits an enemy, it decreases the target's All-Attribute DMG RES by 20%, lasting 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. Characters with Harmonic Shield deal 20% more DMG, and when Robin is switched in as the active character, she gains 1 Accent Beat.

items.name: [易损][卡芙卡]狩影不息-Lv.50
items.description:
卡芙卡的专属战术棱镜。
队伍中任意角色触发[紊乱]效果时，削减敌人10%「恶噪护盾」。15秒内最多触发一次。
卡芙卡发动[强化特殊技]后，下次交替发动的另一种强化特殊技获得增益：[暮夜猎曲·宣叙]的异常积蓄效率提升200%；[暮夜猎曲·咏叹]最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发1次[掣电]；卡芙卡造成[紊乱]伤害时，使敌人对应属性的属性伤害抗性降低5%，持续15秒，同属性最多叠加4层，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Kafka's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When any squad member triggers Disorder, enemy's Cacophony Shield is depleted by 10%. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
After Kafka launches EX Special Attack, the next EX Special Attack lauched alternately gets boosted, increasing Nocturne Hunt - Recitative's Anomaly Buildup Rate by 200%; when the final hit of Nocturne Hunt - Aria hits an enemy in Attribute Anomaly, triggering Lightning Surge once; when Kafka deals Disorder damage, decreasing enemy's Attribute DMG RES of the same attribute by 5%, lasting 15s, up to 4 stacks of the same attribute; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [易损][席德]铁誓钢蕊-Lv.50
items.description:
「席德」的专属战术棱镜。
[骸影·征服者]的变身持续时间增加10秒。发动「强力斩击」后，「席德」和[正兵]的暴击伤害提升20%，持续60秒。重复触发刷新持续时间。
[正兵]效果激活时，「席德」的能量自动回复提升0.8点/秒，强化特殊技命中敌人获得的钢能提升30%。[普通攻击：落华·崩坠二式]命中时，回复自身30点钢能。
items.descriptionEn:
Seed's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Etheric Phantom: Conqueror's transformation duration increases by 10s. After using Power Slash, Seed's and Vanguard's CRIT DMG increases by 20% for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When Vanguard is active, Seed's Energy Regen is increased by 0.8 per second, and Steel Charge gained by hitting enemies with EX Special Attack is increased by 30%. When Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form hits an enemy, 30 Steel Charge is restored.

items.name: [易损][薇薇安]心有所系-Lv.50
items.description:
薇薇安的专属战术棱镜。
发动「强力斩击」后，全队角色回复40点能量，90秒内最多触发一次。
自身触发[异放]时，获得1点[飞羽]，12秒内最多触发一次。强化特殊技命中处于异常状态的敌人触发一次[异放]效果，固定结算500%倍率的对应属性异常伤害。强化特殊技命中敌人或触发[异放]时，全队角色异常精通提升15点，持续30秒，最多叠加5层。重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Vivian's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When Powerful Slash is launched, all squad members gain 40 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 90s.
Trigger Abloom and gain 1 Flight Feather, up to once every 12s. When EX Special Attack hits an enemy in Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing Attribute Anomaly damage of the same attribute with a multiplier of 500%. When EX Special Attack hits an enemy or triggers Abloom, all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency increases by 15, lasting 30s, up to 5 stacks; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [易损][雨果]一掷千金-Lv.50
items.description:
雨果的专属战术棱镜。
对首领级敌人使用「强力斩击」后，额外造成一次原伤害30%的伤害，该效果60秒内最多触发一次。
自身触发[决算]时，[决算]的伤害提高40%，并回复自身12点能量，能量回复效果25秒内最多触发一次。雨果终结技的终结一击命中失衡状态下的敌人时，延长敌人失衡时间3秒，并回复自身1000点喧响值，喧响值回复效果50秒内最多触发一次。
items.descriptionEn:
Hugo's exclusive Tactical Prism.
After using Powerful Slash on a Boss-Rank enemy, deal additional DMG equal to 30% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
When the character triggers Totalize, the DMG of Totalize increases by 40% and restores 12 Energy. Energy Generation can trigger once every 25s. When the Finishing Move of Hugo's Ultimate hits a Stunned enemy, it extends the enemy's Stunned duration by 3s and restores 1,000 Decibels. Decibels restoration can trigger once every 50s.

items.name: [易损][悠真]单曲循环-Lv.50
items.description:
悠真的专属战术棱镜。
装备同名武备时仅可触发一次，获得2个[骸影·畸变骸蚁]（通过该效果获得的道具不可带出）。自身对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升15%。攻击拥有「恶噪护盾」的敌人时无视对方20%电属性伤害抗性。
进入接战状态时，放置6个[电壶]。触发极限闪避时，生成2个电壶。对敌人施加[电囚]效果或自身极限闪避成功时，攻击无视敌人50%防御力，持续15秒。重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Harumasa's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Grants 2 Etheric Phantom: Mutant Formicarrier (item obtained from this effect cannot be extracted), triggered only once if more than one piece of the same Gear is equipped. The character's reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield increases by 15%. When attacking enemies with Cacophony Shield, ignores 20% of the target's Electric DMG RES.
When the character enters combat, 6 Electro Quivers are placed. When Perfect Dodge is triggered, 2 Electro Quivers are generated. When inflicting Electro Prison on enemies or successfully performing a Perfect Dodge, the character attacks ignoring 50% of the enemies' DEF, lasting 15s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [易损][莱特]KO之拳-Lv.50
items.description:
莱特的专属战术棱镜。
全队代理人每拥有1层昂扬，对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升0.5%。「强力斩击」触发决算效果时，额外削减敌人10%「恶噪护盾」，额外积累20%失衡值。
敌人受到攻击进入失衡状态后失衡易伤倍率提升30%。[普通攻击:L式轰鸣拳]命中敌人时，自身冲击力提升12%，持续30秒。长按闪避可以发动[挑衅]，处于[挑衅]状态时，受到敌人攻击会触发招架。[普通攻击:L式轰鸣拳]命中敌人或成功招架时，全队角色暴击伤害提升32%，持续30秒。暴击伤害提升效果不叠加，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Lighter's exclusive Tactical Prism.
For each stack of Elation on every Agent in the whole squad, the reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield increases by 0.5%. When Powerful Slash triggers the Totalize effect, it additionally reduces the enemy's Cacophony Shield by 10% and additionally accumulates 20% Daze.
When an enemy is attacked and Stunned, the Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30%. When Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist hits an enemy, this character's Impact increases by 12% for 30s. Holding dodge activates Provoke. While in the Provoke state, taking an attack from an enemy triggers a parry. When Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist hits an enemy or successfully parries, all squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 32% for 30s. The CRIT DMG boost does not stack; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [易损][青衣]惊堂一棍-Lv.50
items.description:
青衣的专属战术棱镜。
进入接战状态时，青衣的[闪络电压]回复至上限。[普通攻击:醉花月云转]对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升20%，每击退一次[猎犬·乌利迪姆]，敌人进入失衡状态后失衡持续时间延长1秒。至多延长3秒。
 [普通攻击:醉花月云转]终结一击命中敌人时，为敌人施加20层[羁服]，每层[羁服]降低敌人3%防御力。
items.descriptionEn:
Qingyi's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When Qingyi enters combat, her Flash Connect Voltage is restored to its maximum. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms's reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield is increased by 20%. Each time The Hound - Ulidim is knocked back, the Stun duration after the enemy enters the Stunned state is extended by 1s. Max extension: 3s.
 Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms's Finishing Move hits apply 20 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy. Each stack of Subjugation reduces the enemy's DEF by 3%.

items.name: [易损][凯撒]猛冲直撞-Lv.50
items.description:
凯撒的专属战术棱镜。
对首领级敌人发动「强力斩击」后，召唤「索贝克」的幻影攻击敌人。每60秒可触发一次（不视为使用「骸影」，「骸影·索贝克」在场期间无法触发）。「骸影·索贝克」造成的伤害增加30%，护盾持续时间增加10秒。
触发[荣光之盾]后，处于后场的角色也能享受该效果。处于[格挡架势]时，自身受到的伤害降低20%。触发[额外能力:战意激昂]时，造成的伤害提升效果额外提升25%，并使周围敌人降低16%全属性伤害抗性。
items.descriptionEn:
Caesar's exclusive Tactical Prism.
After using Powerful Slash on a Boss-Rank enemy, summons a phantom of Sobek to attack the enemy. Can trigger once every 60s (not counted as using an Etheric Phantom; cannot trigger while Etheric Phantom: Sobek is on field). DMG dealt by Etheric Phantom: Sobek increases by 30%, and shield duration increases by 10s.
After Radiant Aegis is triggered, off-field characters also benefit from this effect. While in guard stance, damage taken is reduced by 20%. When Additional Ability: Battle Spirit is activated, the DMG boost effect is additionally increased by 25%, and nearby enemies' All-Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 16%.

items.name: [易损][朱鸢]结案陈词-Lv.50
items.description:
朱鸢的专属战术棱镜。
每击退一次[猎犬·乌利迪姆]，自身对敌人造成的伤害提升15%，最多提升45%。进入接战状态时，朱鸢的[强化霰弹]回复至9颗。
未进入接战状态时，每3秒恢复1枚[强化霰弹]。[冲刺攻击]命中敌人时，回复2枚强化霰弹，每5秒最多触发一次。[压制模式]下，自身造成的伤害无视目标40%防御，命中处于失衡状态的敌人时，造成的伤害额外提升50%。
items.descriptionEn:
Zhu Yuan's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Each time The Hound - Ulidim is knocked back, damage dealt by the character is increased by 15%, up to a maximum increase of 45%. When in combat, Zhu Yuan's Enhanced Shotshells are restored to 9.
While not in combat, 1 Enhanced Shotshells is restored every 3s. When Dash Attack hits an enemy, it restores 2 Enhanced Shotshells, triggered once every 5s. When in Suppressive Mode, damage dealt by the character ignores 40% of the target's DEF, and when the character hits a Stunned enemy, damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%.

卡芙卡发动[强化特殊技]后，下次交替发动的另一种强化特殊技获得增益：[暮夜猎曲·宣叙]的异常积蓄效率提升200%；[暮夜猎曲·咏叹]最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发1次[掣电]；卡芙卡造成[紊乱]伤害时，使敌人对应属性的属性伤害抗性降低5%，持续15秒，同属性最多叠加4层，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Kafka's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When any squad member triggers Disorder, enemy's Cacophony Shield is depleted by 10%. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
After Kafka launches EX Special Attack, the next EX Special Attack lauched alternately gets boosted, increasing Nocturne Hunt - Recitative's Anomaly Buildup Rate by 200%; when the final hit of Nocturne Hunt - Aria hits an enemy in Attribute Anomaly, triggering Lightning Surge once; when Kafka deals Disorder damage, decreasing enemy's Attribute DMG RES of the same attribute by 5%, lasting 15s, up to 4 stacks of the same attribute; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [席德]铁誓钢蕊-Lv.60
items.description:
「席德」的专属战术棱镜。
[骸影·征服者]的变身持续时间增加10秒。发动「强力斩击」后，「席德」和[正兵]的暴击伤害提升20%，持续60秒。重复触发刷新持续时间。
[正兵]效果激活时，「席德」的能量自动回复提升0.8点/秒，强化特殊技命中敌人获得的钢能提升30%。[普通攻击：落华·崩坠二式]命中时，回复自身30点钢能。
items.descriptionEn:
Seed's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Etheric Phantom: Conqueror's transformation duration increases by 10s. After using Power Slash, Seed's and Vanguard's CRIT DMG increases by 20% for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When Vanguard is active, Seed's Energy Regen is increased by 0.8 per second, and Steel Charge gained by hitting enemies with EX Special Attack is increased by 30%. When Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form hits an enemy, 30 Steel Charge is restored.

items.name: [薇薇安]心有所系-Lv.60
items.description:
薇薇安的专属战术棱镜。
发动「强力斩击」后，全队角色回复40点能量，90秒内最多触发一次。
自身触发[异放]时，获得1点[飞羽]，12秒内最多触发一次。强化特殊技命中处于异常状态的敌人触发一次[异放]效果，固定结算500%倍率的对应属性异常伤害。强化特殊技命中敌人或触发[异放]时，全队角色异常精通提升15点，持续30秒，最多叠加5层。重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Vivian's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When Powerful Slash is launched, all squad members gain 40 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 90s.
Trigger Abloom and gain 1 Flight Feather, up to once every 12s. When EX Special Attack hits an enemy in Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing Attribute Anomaly damage of the same attribute with a multiplier of 500%. When EX Special Attack hits an enemy or triggers Abloom, all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency increases by 15, lasting 30s, up to 5 stacks; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [雨果]一掷千金-Lv.60
items.description:
雨果的专属战术棱镜。
对首领级敌人使用「强力斩击」后，额外造成一次原伤害30%的伤害，该效果60秒内最多触发一次。
自身触发[决算]时，[决算]的伤害提高40%，并回复自身12点能量，能量回复效果25秒内最多触发一次。雨果终结技的终结一击命中失衡状态下的敌人时，延长敌人失衡时间3秒，并回复自身1000点喧响值，喧响值回复效果50秒内最多触发一次。
items.descriptionEn:
Hugo's exclusive Tactical Prism.
After using Powerful Slash on a Boss-Rank enemy, deal additional DMG equal to 30% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
When the character triggers Totalize, the DMG of Totalize increases by 40% and restores 12 Energy. Energy Generation can trigger once every 25s. When the Finishing Move of Hugo's Ultimate hits a Stunned enemy, it extends the enemy's Stunned duration by 3s and restores 1,000 Decibels. Decibels restoration can trigger once every 50s.

items.name: [悠真]单曲循环-Lv.60
items.description:
悠真的专属战术棱镜。
装备同名武备时仅可触发一次，获得2个[骸影·畸变骸蚁]（通过该效果获得的道具不可带出）。自身对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升15%。攻击拥有「恶噪护盾」的敌人时无视对方20%电属性伤害抗性。
进入接战状态时，放置6个[电壶]。触发极限闪避时，生成2个电壶。对敌人施加[电囚]效果或自身极限闪避成功时，攻击无视敌人50%防御力，持续15秒。重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Harumasa's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Grants 2 Etheric Phantom: Mutant Formicarrier (item obtained from this effect cannot be extracted), triggered only once if more than one piece of the same Gear is equipped. The character's reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield increases by 15%. When attacking enemies with Cacophony Shield, ignores 20% of the target's Electric DMG RES.
When the character enters combat, 6 Electro Quivers are placed. When Perfect Dodge is triggered, 2 Electro Quivers are generated. When inflicting Electro Prison on enemies or successfully performing a Perfect Dodge, the character attacks ignoring 50% of the enemies' DEF, lasting 15s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [莱特]KO之拳-Lv.60
items.description:
莱特的专属战术棱镜。
全队代理人每拥有1层昂扬，对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升0.5%。「强力斩击」触发决算效果时，额外削减敌人10%「恶噪护盾」，额外积累20%失衡值。
敌人受到攻击进入失衡状态后失衡易伤倍率提升30%。[普通攻击:L式轰鸣拳]命中敌人时，自身冲击力提升12%，持续30秒。长按闪避可以发动[挑衅]，处于[挑衅]状态时，受到敌人攻击会触发招架。[普通攻击:L式轰鸣拳]命中敌人或成功招架时，全队角色暴击伤害提升32%，持续30秒。暴击伤害提升效果不叠加，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Lighter's exclusive Tactical Prism.
For each stack of Elation on every Agent in the whole squad, the reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield increases by 0.5%. When Powerful Slash triggers the Totalize effect, it additionally reduces the enemy's Cacophony Shield by 10% and additionally accumulates 20% Daze.
When an enemy is attacked and Stunned, the Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30%. When Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist hits an enemy, this character's Impact increases by 12% for 30s. Holding dodge activates Provoke. While in the Provoke state, taking an attack from an enemy triggers a parry. When Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist hits an enemy or successfully parries, all squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 32% for 30s. The CRIT DMG boost does not stack; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [青衣]惊堂一棍-Lv.60
items.description:
青衣的专属战术棱镜。
进入接战状态时，青衣的[闪络电压]回复至上限。[普通攻击:醉花月云转]对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升20%，每击退一次[猎犬·乌利迪姆]，敌人进入失衡状态后失衡持续时间延长1秒。至多延长3秒。
 [普通攻击:醉花月云转]终结一击命中敌人时，为敌人施加20层[羁服]，每层[羁服]降低敌人3%防御力。
items.descriptionEn:
Qingyi's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When Qingyi enters combat, her Flash Connect Voltage is restored to its maximum. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms's reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield is increased by 20%. Each time The Hound - Ulidim is knocked back, the Stun duration after the enemy enters the Stunned state is extended by 1s. Max extension: 3s.
 Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms's Finishing Move hits apply 20 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy. Each stack of Subjugation reduces the enemy's DEF by 3%.

items.name: [凯撒]猛冲直撞-Lv.60
items.description:
凯撒的专属战术棱镜。
对首领级敌人发动「强力斩击」后，召唤「索贝克」的幻影攻击敌人。每60秒可触发一次（不视为使用「骸影」，「骸影·索贝克」在场期间无法触发）。「骸影·索贝克」造成的伤害增加30%，护盾持续时间增加10秒。
触发[荣光之盾]后，处于后场的角色也能享受该效果。处于[格挡架势]时，自身受到的伤害降低20%。触发[额外能力:战意激昂]时，造成的伤害提升效果额外提升25%，并使周围敌人降低16%全属性伤害抗性。
items.descriptionEn:
Caesar's exclusive Tactical Prism.
After using Powerful Slash on a Boss-Rank enemy, summons a phantom of Sobek to attack the enemy. Can trigger once every 60s (not counted as using an Etheric Phantom; cannot trigger while Etheric Phantom: Sobek is on field). DMG dealt by Etheric Phantom: Sobek increases by 30%, and shield duration increases by 10s.
After Radiant Aegis is triggered, off-field characters also benefit from this effect. While in guard stance, damage taken is reduced by 20%. When Additional Ability: Battle Spirit is activated, the DMG boost effect is additionally increased by 25%, and nearby enemies' All-Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 16%.

items.name: [朱鸢]结案陈词-Lv.60
items.description:
朱鸢的专属战术棱镜。
每击退一次[猎犬·乌利迪姆]，自身对敌人造成的伤害提升15%，最多提升45%。进入接战状态时，朱鸢的[强化霰弹]回复至9颗。
未进入接战状态时，每3秒恢复1枚[强化霰弹]。[冲刺攻击]命中敌人时，回复2枚强化霰弹，每5秒最多触发一次。[压制模式]下，自身造成的伤害无视目标40%防御，命中处于失衡状态的敌人时，造成的伤害额外提升50%。
items.descriptionEn:
Zhu Yuan's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Each time The Hound - Ulidim is knocked back, damage dealt by the character is increased by 15%, up to a maximum increase of 45%. When in combat, Zhu Yuan's Enhanced Shotshells are restored to 9.
While not in combat, 1 Enhanced Shotshells is restored every 3s. When Dash Attack hits an enemy, it restores 2 Enhanced Shotshells, triggered once every 5s. When in Suppressive Mode, damage dealt by the character ignores 40% of the target's DEF, and when the character hits a Stunned enemy, damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%.

items.name: [挽昼]心灯如帜-Lv.50
items.nameEn: [Sunbringer] Lamp of the Heart, Banner of Hope - Lv.50
items.description:
挽昼的专属战术棱镜。
装备同名武备时仅可触发一次，获得1个[骸影·梦游布]。发动「强力斩击」后，为敌人积攒1层残痕。15秒内最多触发一次。异体技造成的30%伤害可以转化为目标的[烬痕]。发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]命中敌人时，额外削减其25%「恶噪护盾」，该效果对同一名敌人仅可触发一次。
挽昼消耗锐能使用强化特殊技时，回复40点愿火。自身受到致命伤害时，立刻回复10%最大生命值，并获得生命值上限30%的护盾，持续60秒，每1200秒可以触发一次。发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]后，无视敌人32%防御力，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Sunbringer's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When equipping Gear of the same name, this effect can only trigger once, granting 1 [Etheric Phantom - Sleepwalkerboo]. After using "Strong Slash," apply 1 floor of Gash to the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 15s. 30% of DMG dealt by Alter Skills can be converted into the target's [Embermark]. When [Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades] hits an enemy, it deals an extra 25% reduction to their "Cacophony Shield." This effect can only trigger once per enemy.
When Sunbringer consumes Sharpness to use an EX Special Attack, restore 40 Wishfire. When taking fatal DMG, instantly restore 10% of Max HP and gain a shield equal to 30% of Max HP for 60s. This effect can trigger once every 1,200s. After using [Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades], ignore 32% of enemy DEF for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [知更鸟]星河咏叹-Lv.50
items.description:
知更鸟的专属战术棱镜。
使用[骸影]时，全队角色获得相当于自身最大生命值10%的护盾，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。任意角色拥有护盾时，队伍受到的侵蚀值降低至原本的85%。
[强化特殊技：震律齐鸣]命中敌人时，降低其20%全属性伤害抗性，持续30秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；拥有[和鸣护盾]的角色造成的伤害提升20%，知更鸟被切换为当前操作中角色时获得1点[重音节拍]。
items.descriptionEn:
Robin's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When Etheric Phantom is used, all squad members gain a shield equal to 10% of their max HP, lasting 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When any character has a shield, Corruption taken by the squad is reduced to 85% of the original value.
When EX Special Attack: Seismic Chorus hits an enemy, it decreases the target's All-Attribute DMG RES by 20%, lasting 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. Characters with Harmonic Shield deal 20% more DMG, and when Robin is switched in as the active character, she gains 1 Accent Beat.

items.name: [卡芙卡]狩影不息-Lv.50
items.description:
卡芙卡的专属战术棱镜。
队伍中任意角色触发[紊乱]效果时，削减敌人10%「恶噪护盾」。15秒内最多触发一次。

该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁凯撒专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：对首领级敌人发动「强力斩击」后，召唤「索贝克」的幻影攻击敌人。每60秒可触发一次（不视为使用「骸影」，「骸影·索贝克」在场期间无法触发）。「骸影·索贝克」造成的伤害增加30%，护盾持续时间增加10秒。
触发[荣光之盾]后，处于后场的角色也能享受该效果。处于[格挡架势]时，自身受到的伤害降低20%。触发[额外能力:战意激昂]时，造成的伤害提升效果额外提升25%，并使周围敌人降低16%全属性伤害抗性。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Caesar's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: After using Powerful Slash on a Boss-Rank enemy, summons a phantom of Sobek to attack the enemy. Can trigger once every 60s (not counted as using an Etheric Phantom; cannot trigger while Etheric Phantom: Sobek is on field). DMG dealt by Etheric Phantom: Sobek increases by 30%, and shield duration increases by 10s.
After Radiant Aegis is triggered, off-field characters also benefit from this effect. While in guard stance, damage taken is reduced by 20%. When Additional Ability: Battle Spirit is activated, the DMG boost effect is additionally increased by 25%, and nearby enemies' All-Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 16%.

items.name: [蓝图][朱鸢]结案陈词-Lv.50
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁朱鸢专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：每击退一次[猎犬·乌利迪姆]，自身对敌人造成的伤害提升15%，最多提升45%。进入接战状态时，朱鸢的[强化霰弹]回复至9颗。
未进入接战状态时，每3秒恢复1枚[强化霰弹]。[冲刺攻击]命中敌人时，回复2枚强化霰弹，每5秒最多触发一次。[压制模式]下，自身造成的伤害无视目标40%防御，命中处于失衡状态的敌人时，造成的伤害额外提升50%。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Zhu Yuan's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: Each time The Hound - Ulidim is knocked back, damage dealt by the character is increased by 15%, up to a maximum increase of 45%. When in combat, Zhu Yuan's Enhanced Shotshells are restored to 9.
While not in combat, 1 Enhanced Shotshells is restored every 3s. When Dash Attack hits an enemy, it restores 2 Enhanced Shotshells, triggered once every 5s. When in Suppressive Mode, damage dealt by the character ignores 40% of the target's DEF, and when the character hits a Stunned enemy, damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%.

items.name: [蓝图][挽昼]心灯如帜-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁挽昼专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：装备同名武备时仅可触发一次，获得1个[骸影·梦游布]。发动「强力斩击」后，为敌人积攒1层残痕。15秒内最多触发一次。异体技造成的30%伤害可以转化为目标的[烬痕]。发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]命中敌人时，额外削减其25%「恶噪护盾」，该效果对同一名敌人仅可触发一次。
挽昼消耗锐能使用强化特殊技时，回复40点愿火。自身受到致命伤害时，立刻回复10%最大生命值，并获得生命值上限30%的护盾，持续60秒，每1200秒可以触发一次。发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]后，无视敌人32%防御力，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Sunbringer's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: When equipping Gear of the same name, this effect can only trigger once, granting 1 [Etheric Phantom - Sleepwalkerboo]. After using "Strong Slash," apply 1 floor of Gash to the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 15s. 30% of DMG dealt by Alter Skills can be converted into the target's [Embermark]. When [Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades] hits an enemy, it deals an extra 25% reduction to their "Cacophony Shield." This effect can only trigger once per enemy.
When Sunbringer consumes Sharpness to use an EX Special Attack, restore 40 Wishfire. When taking fatal DMG, instantly restore 10% of Max HP and gain a shield equal to 30% of Max HP for 60s. This effect can trigger once every 1,200s. After using [Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades], ignore 32% of enemy DEF for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [蓝图][知更鸟]星河咏叹-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁知更鸟专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：使用[骸影]时，全队角色获得相当于自身最大生命值10%的护盾，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。任意角色拥有护盾时，队伍受到的侵蚀值降低至原本的85%。
[强化特殊技：震律齐鸣]命中敌人时，降低其20%全属性伤害抗性，持续30秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；拥有[和鸣护盾]的角色造成的伤害提升20%，知更鸟被切换为当前操作中角色时获得1点[重音节拍]。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Robin's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: When Etheric Phantom is used, all squad members gain a shield equal to 10% of their max HP, lasting 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. When any character has a shield, Corruption taken by the squad is reduced to 85% of the original value.
When EX Special Attack: Seismic Chorus hits an enemy, it decreases the target's All-Attribute DMG RES by 20%, lasting 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration. Characters with Harmonic Shield deal 20% more DMG, and when Robin is switched in as the active character, she gains 1 Accent Beat.

items.name: [蓝图][卡芙卡]狩影不息-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁卡芙卡专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：队伍中任意角色触发[紊乱]效果时，削减敌人10%「恶噪护盾」。15秒内最多触发一次。
卡芙卡发动[强化特殊技]后，下次交替发动的另一种强化特殊技获得增益：[暮夜猎曲·宣叙]的异常积蓄效率提升200%；[暮夜猎曲·咏叹]最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发1次[掣电]；卡芙卡造成[紊乱]伤害时，使敌人对应属性的属性伤害抗性降低5%，持续15秒，同属性最多叠加4层，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Kafka's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: When any squad member triggers Disorder, enemy's Cacophony Shield is depleted by 10%. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
After Kafka launches EX Special Attack, the next EX Special Attack lauched alternately gets boosted, increasing Nocturne Hunt - Recitative's Anomaly Buildup Rate by 200%; when the final hit of Nocturne Hunt - Aria hits an enemy in Attribute Anomaly, triggering Lightning Surge once; when Kafka deals Disorder damage, decreasing enemy's Attribute DMG RES of the same attribute by 5%, lasting 15s, up to 4 stacks of the same attribute; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [蓝图][席德]铁誓钢蕊-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁[席德]专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：[骸影·征服者]的变身持续时间增加10秒。发动「强力斩击」后，「席德」和[正兵]的暴击伤害提升20%，持续60秒。重复触发刷新持续时间。
[正兵]效果激活时，「席德」的能量自动回复提升0.8点/秒，强化特殊技命中敌人获得的钢能提升30%。[普通攻击：落华·崩坠二式]命中时，回复自身30点钢能。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Seed's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: Etheric Phantom: Conqueror's transformation duration increases by 10s. After using Power Slash, Seed's and Vanguard's CRIT DMG increases by 20% for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When Vanguard is active, Seed's Energy Regen is increased by 0.8 per second, and Steel Charge gained by hitting enemies with EX Special Attack is increased by 30%. When Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form hits an enemy, 30 Steel Charge is restored.

items.name: [蓝图][薇薇安]心有所系-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁薇薇安专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：发动「强力斩击」后，全队角色回复40点能量，90秒内最多触发一次。
自身触发[异放]时，获得1点[飞羽]，12秒内最多触发一次。强化特殊技命中处于异常状态的敌人触发一次[异放]效果，固定结算500%倍率的对应属性异常伤害。强化特殊技命中敌人或触发[异放]时，全队角色异常精通提升15点，持续30秒，最多叠加5层。重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Vivian's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: When Powerful Slash is launched, all squad members gain 40 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 90s.
Trigger Abloom and gain 1 Flight Feather, up to once every 12s. When EX Special Attack hits an enemy in Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing Attribute Anomaly damage of the same attribute with a multiplier of 500%. When EX Special Attack hits an enemy or triggers Abloom, all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency increases by 15, lasting 30s, up to 5 stacks; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [蓝图][雨果]一掷千金-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁雨果专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：对首领级敌人使用「强力斩击」后，额外造成一次原伤害30%的伤害，该效果60秒内最多触发一次。
自身触发[决算]时，[决算]的伤害提高40%，并回复自身12点能量，能量回复效果25秒内最多触发一次。雨果终结技的终结一击命中失衡状态下的敌人时，延长敌人失衡时间3秒，并回复自身1000点喧响值，喧响值回复效果50秒内最多触发一次。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Hugo's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: After using Powerful Slash on a Boss-Rank enemy, deal additional DMG equal to 30% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
When the character triggers Totalize, the DMG of Totalize increases by 40% and restores 12 Energy. Energy Generation can trigger once every 25s. When the Finishing Move of Hugo's Ultimate hits a Stunned enemy, it extends the enemy's Stunned duration by 3s and restores 1,000 Decibels. Decibels restoration can trigger once every 50s.

items.name: [蓝图][悠真]单曲循环-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁悠真专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：装备同名武备时仅可触发一次，获得2个[骸影·畸变骸蚁]（通过该效果获得的道具不可带出）。自身对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升15%。攻击拥有「恶噪护盾」的敌人时无视对方20%电属性伤害抗性。
进入接战状态时，放置6个[电壶]。触发极限闪避时，生成2个电壶。对敌人施加[电囚]效果或自身极限闪避成功时，攻击无视敌人50%防御力，持续15秒。重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Harumasa's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: Grants 2 Etheric Phantom: Mutant Formicarrier (item obtained from this effect cannot be extracted), triggered only once if more than one piece of the same Gear is equipped. The character's reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield increases by 15%. When attacking enemies with Cacophony Shield, ignores 20% of the target's Electric DMG RES.
When the character enters combat, 6 Electro Quivers are placed. When Perfect Dodge is triggered, 2 Electro Quivers are generated. When inflicting Electro Prison on enemies or successfully performing a Perfect Dodge, the character attacks ignoring 50% of the enemies' DEF, lasting 15s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [蓝图][莱特]KO之拳-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁莱特专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：全队代理人每拥有1层昂扬，对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升0.5%。「强力斩击」触发决算效果时，额外削减敌人10%「恶噪护盾」，额外积累20%失衡值。
敌人受到攻击进入失衡状态后失衡易伤倍率提升30%。[普通攻击:L式轰鸣拳]命中敌人时，自身冲击力提升12%，持续30秒。长按闪避可以发动[挑衅]，处于[挑衅]状态时，受到敌人攻击会触发招架。[普通攻击:L式轰鸣拳]命中敌人或成功招架时，全队角色暴击伤害提升32%，持续30秒。暴击伤害提升效果不叠加，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
items.descriptionEn:
Use this Blueprint at the Smart Workshop to unlock the recipe for Lighter's exclusive Tactical Prism. Obtained through investigations or purchased from Boojee's Store - Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale.
Item Effect: For each stack of Elation on every Agent in the whole squad, the reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield increases by 0.5%. When Powerful Slash triggers the Totalize effect, it additionally reduces the enemy's Cacophony Shield by 10% and additionally accumulates 20% Daze.
When an enemy is attacked and Stunned, the Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30%. When Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist hits an enemy, this character's Impact increases by 12% for 30s. Holding dodge activates Provoke. While in the Provoke state, taking an attack from an enemy triggers a parry. When Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist hits an enemy or successfully parries, all squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 32% for 30s. The CRIT DMG boost does not stack; repeated triggers reset the duration.

items.name: [蓝图][青衣]惊堂一棍-Lv.60
items.description:
该蓝图可用于在智造工坊解锁青衣专属战术棱镜的制作。可通过调查探索获得或大富豪商店-常驻商店-蓝图直售购买。
道具效果：进入接战状态时，青衣的[闪络电压]回复至上限。[普通攻击:醉花月云转]对「恶噪护盾」的削减效率提升20%，每击退一次[猎犬·乌利迪姆]，敌人进入失衡状态后失衡持续时间延长1秒。至多延长3秒。
 [普通攻击:醉花月云转]终结一击命中敌人时，为敌人施加20层[羁服]，每层[羁服]降低敌人3%防御力。
items.descriptionEn:

Item Effect: When Qingyi enters combat, her Flash Connect Voltage is restored to its maximum. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms's reduction efficiency against Cacophony Shield is increased by 20%. Each time The Hound - Ulidim is knocked back, the Stun duration after the enemy enters the Stunned state is extended by 1s. Max extension: 3s.
 Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms's Finishing Move hits apply 20 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy. Each stack of Subjugation reduces the enemy's DEF by 3%.
